pages.text: Allah the Exalted says: ﴿وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ عِلۡمٗاۖ وَقَالَا ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٖ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'And We gave Dawud and Sulayman knowledge, and they said: Praise be to Allah, who has favoured us over many of His believing servants.' And Dawud and Sulayman (peace be upon them) acted on that knowledge.
Sulayman inherited from his father Dawud prophethood, knowledge and kingship. And Allah taught him the speech of the birds, and gave him of everything that was needed.

His soldiers were gathered for Sulayman, from the jinn, mankind and the birds, on a march of theirs. Many as they were, they were in good order: over each kind of them was one who kept the first waiting for the last, so that they all stood in order.

When they reached the valley of the ants, an ant warned the ants: ﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'O ants, go into your homes, so that Sulayman and his soldiers do not crush you without knowing it.'

Sulayman smiled, laughing at her words, because she understood and was guided to warn the ants. And he felt Allah's blessing upon him, and turned to Him in du'a: ﴿رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'My Lord, inspire me and help me to thank You for Your blessing which You have given to me and to my parents, and to do good deeds that please You; and by Your mercy, admit me among Your righteous servants.'

Among the lessons of these verses is the honour of knowledge and the high rank of its people: Allah gave Dawud and Sulayman knowledge, and they acted on it. Another is that the ant understood, and was guided to warn the ants. And another is that a blessing is met with thanks and du'a, as Sulayman (peace be upon him) did when he felt Allah's blessing upon him.
